## What changes and why?

Describe the problem and the resulting behaviour. Link related issues where applicable.

## Validation

Describe the checks you ran and their results. State what remains untested.

- [ ] Relevant tests and catalogue validation pass, or any exceptions are explained.
- [ ] Interface changes have been checked on desktop/mobile, including keyboard navigation and focus where relevant.
- [ ] Playback/scheduling changes have been checked for video, audio and programme/advert transitions where relevant.
- [ ] Existing owner media, programming, settings and persistent storage are preserved; migration or rollback implications are explained.
- [ ] Documentation is updated where behaviour or setup changes.
- [ ] No credentials, private station data, media files or hosted-only catalogue changes are included.

Mark items that do not apply as N/A with a short explanation. Do not include sensitive logs or private media.

## Screenshots or examples

For visible changes, include suitable desktop/mobile examples with private details removed.

## Risks or follow-up

Note compatibility limitations, deployment requirements or remaining work. Report security vulnerabilities privately using SECURITY.md rather than describing an undisclosed exploit here.
